name: @cotal-ai/connector-codex
description: Cotal connector for OpenAI Codex: a host-mode peer driving codex app-server, and a plugin that connects your own Codex conversations to local or signed-in meshes.

scripts.test: tsx smoke/codex-args.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/model-catalog.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/thread-binding.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/mcp-version.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/personal-binding.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/personal-approval-resume.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/setup-refresh.smoke.ts && tsx smoke/plugin-list-buffer.smoke.ts
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && pnpm run bundle && node ../../scripts/plugin-manifest.mjs
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify-whitespace --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cotalCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cotalCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/host-main.ts --bundle --minify-whitespace --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/host.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cotalCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cotalCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/personal-main.ts --bundle --minify-whitespace --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/personal.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cotalCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cotalCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('../connector-core/src/docs-index.bin','dist/docs-index.bin')" && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('../connector-core/src/docs-bundle.bin','dist/docs-bundle.bin')"
